programme.desc: Naya menyadari bahwa masa-masa sekolah menengahnya tidak seasyik kebanyakan remaja lainnya. programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E2
programme.desc: Naya terbangun dan menjerit histeris ketika melihat Jetta sungguhan sedang berbaring di sampingnya, tersenyum manis, dan menyapanya. programme.title: A Big Ray Of Sunshine The Grove Part One - Carly Booth

programme.desc: Naya merasa gugup ketika Queena memintanya untuk memperkenalkannya kepada Jetta. Saat Naya sedang memikirkan Jetta, tiba-tiba Jetta muncul dan membuat suasana kantin menjadi ramai. Pada saat yang sama, Majja datang dan meminta Jetta untuk pergi. Hampir terjadi pertengkaran, dan Queena yang marah pun meminta Majja untuk mengakhiri hubungan mereka.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E5
programme.desc: Hari-hari Naya menjadi berbeda sejak kedatangan Jetta. Kini Naya bisa hang out di mal dan menghabiskan waktu bersama Jetta. programme.title: The Three Hole 14 Club Challenge Insane Forfeit For The Loser

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E7
programme.desc: Untuk pertama kalinya, Naya kabur dari rumah dan menginap semalam di rumah Queena. Namun, Keyla menjebak Naya dan memaksanya untuk melepas pakaian dan merokok. programme.title: Civilisations S1, Ep 1
programme.desc: Sejarawan Simon Schama menelaah peran penting yang dimainkan oleh seni dan imajinasi kreatif dalam pembentukan umat manusia itu sendiri. Ia menelusuri asal-usul kreativitas manusia yang paling purba melalui jejak-jejak pertama yang diketahui, yang dibuat sekitar 80.000 tahun lalu di gua-gua Afrika Selatan. Seiring berjalannya waktu dan berkembangnya imajinasi, ia menemukan bahwa semua peradaban meyakini diri mereka abadi, namun semuanya pada akhirnya ditakdirkan untuk runtuh.

programme.desc: Film thriller nan unik ini sama sekali tidak seseram judulnya, berkisah tentang seekor ular gagah berani dan berbudi luhur yang merusak perangkap, melawan tikus pemakan bayi, dan bahkan mengalahkan sejumlah geng saingan.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Seorang mantan ahli kung fu gaya monyet yang dikalahkan oleh seorang penjahat kejam diyakinkan oleh murid mudanya untuk mengajarinya kung fu gaya monyet demi membalas rasa malunya.

programme.title: The Tiger And The Widow
programme.desc: Hui Ying-hung terlibat dalam sebuah jaringan penyelundupan orang-orang hilang dan berada dalam situasi yang membahayakan.

programme.title: Portrait In Crystal
programme.desc: Di film fantasi seni bela diri ini, jenderal Teng Wei Hao curiga bahwa sebuah lukisan kristal telah dikutuk dan menyebabkan beberapa pembunuhan. Ia mengutus anak buahnya untuk menyelidiki pencipta lukisan itu.

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: Sebagai hukuman atas perilaku buruknya, putri Kaisar Jade yang ke-tujuh diusir dari surga dan dikirim untuk tinggal bersama manusia. Di sana, ia jatuh cinta dengan seorang pemuda desa bernama Dong Young.

programme.title: The Singing Killer
programme.desc: Chiang Yi diperas untuk melakukan pencurian perhiasan oleh mantan bosnya yang mengancam akan mengungkap masa lalunya yang kelam. Masalah muncul saat ia mengetahui bahwa cinta pertamanya bekerja di toko itu.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities
programme.desc: Urusan asmara dan moral di era modern hanyalah segelintir masalah dari cerita yang berlatarkan Makau ini. Kisah cinta antara empat anak manusia menjadi cerita utama dalam kisah humor ini.

programme.title: Gambler's Delight
programme.desc: Dalam film tentang perjudian ini, Danny Lee berperan sebagai seorang penjudi putus asa yang melakukan kecurangan saat berjudi di sebuah kasino di Makau. Ia pun harus menghadapi seorang pemimpin geng asal Jepang.

programme.title: The Case Of Disappearances
programme.desc: Ketika Qing Cheng masih remaja, ia diserang oleh monster mutan yang tidak dikenal dan kehilangan keluarga serta ingatannya. Ia dianggap oleh penduduk desa sebagai orang yang tidak menyenangkan yang akan membawa bencana.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: Film ini bercerita tentang seorang imigran gelap asal Tiongkok, Cheung Kwan-chow, dan perjalanannya di New York.

programme.title: Wusong Vs Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song mengetahui perselingkuhan adik iparnya dengan pria kaya bernama Ximen Qing. Song pun dijebak dan diasingkan selama setahun oleh Qing, sementara sang adik dibunuh. Bisakah ia membalas kematian saudaranya?

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: Sebuah film fantasi-horor berlatar belakang Moskow masa kini, di mana masing-masing kekuatan yang mengendalikan siang dan malam saling bertempur.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Selama invasi Jepang ke Cina, seorang seniman bela diri yang kaya terpaksa meninggalkan rumahnya ketika kotanya diduduki. Dengan sedikit sarana untuk memenuhi kebutuhan mereka sendiri, Ip Man dan anggota kota yang tersisa harus menemukan cara untuk bertahan hidup.

programme.title: Confession Of Pain
programme.desc: Seorang detektif membantu temannya menyelidiki kematian misterius ayah mertuanya.

programme.title: Confession Of Pain
programme.desc: Seorang detektif membantu temannya menyelidiki kematian misterius ayah mertuanya.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Seorang badut secara tidak sengaja direkrut oleh seorang pemimpin sekte untuk memata-matai seorang kaisar Tiongkok yang muda dan tidak berpengalaman. Segalanya tidak berjalan sesuai rencana, dan dia akhirnya bekerja untuk beberapa pihak yang saling bertentangan sambil berusaha bertahan hidup di tengah kegilaan tersebut.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: Putra dari keluarga kaya jatuh cinta pada seorang wanita yang hanya akan menikahinya setelah ia menjadi seorang Guru Kung-Fu. Dalam 'Drama Komedi' ini, ia menjadi pahlawan legendaris dengan berusaha menyelamatkan kaisar, dalam pencarian cintanya yang sebenarnya.

programme.title: 36 Secrets Of Courtship
programme.desc: Tiga orang lothario bersaing untuk menjadi kepala sekolah Sekolah Pelatihan Macho Man, sebuah lembaga yang sangat non-monastik yang didedikasikan untuk jenis latihan fisik yang sangat berbeda dengan Shaolin.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun adalah seorang ahli bela diri terampil yang bertarung untuk membalas dendam atas kematian sang kekasih dengan bantuan dari seorang pemimpin geng pengemis.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 2
programme.desc: Perampok kuburan menemukan vampir yang diawetkan. Saat mengangkut vampir anak, mantra yang mengikatnya hilang, dan ia berteman dengan penduduk setempat. Vampir orang tua terbangun dan melarikan diri. Tabib herbal mengejar untuk menghancurkan mereka.

programme.title: Final Justice
programme.desc: Seorang polisi mengandalkan seorang pencuri mobil muda untuk menangkap empat gangster yang berencana merampok seorang pedagang kaya untuk mendapatkan sejumlah besar uang.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: Seorang wanita diperkosa dan dibunuh selama Perang Dunia II. Empat puluh tahun kemudian, ia kembali untuk menghantui para penganiayanya dari Rumah Besar Tao Tao. Seorang profesor dan keluarganya pindah ke rumah itu, hanya untuk kemudian roh-roh tersebut mengambil putra mereka.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Seluruh sekolah disandera saat kompetisi pidato bahasa Inggris berlangsung. Ip Man pun memutuskan untuk bangkit dan menghadapi krisis, serta menemukan bahwa dalangnya adalah sang guru dan teman masa kecilnya.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: Kehidupan seorang sopir taksi Hong Kong berubah mengerikan setelah secara tidak sengaja menabrak seorang penyihir dengan taksinya. Dia memutuskan untuk meminta bantuan penyihir tersebut untuk membalikkan kutukan kepada musuh-musuhnya dengan mengorbankan nyawanya sendiri.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs 3
programme.desc: 10 bulan setelah Yan terbunuh, Ming dipindahkan untuk bekerja di bagian administrasi. Sementara itu, seorang bintang baru, Wing muncul di kepolisian. Ming mencurigainya sebagai mata-mata yang diutus oleh triad.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Petinju dunia kriminal, Lin Feng, diburu oleh triad asal Bangkok kala ia menolak bertarung dalam sebuah pertandingan ilegal. Lin Feng berhasil melarikan diri, tetapi ia kehilangan ingatannya.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: Seorang pria tunanetra, You Ji Ren, bekerja di sebuah pabrik di pulau terpencil. Karena badai, pabrik itu terisolasi dan muncul sesosok monster yang membuat siapa pun berubah menjadi bayangan hitam jika melihatnya.

programme.title: Royal Tramp 2
programme.desc: Wei si badut, yang kemudian menjadi mata-mata rahasia, lalu menjadi pejabat tinggi di istana kekaisaran Tiongkok, berusaha sekuat tenaga untuk menghadapi faksi-faksi yang bertikai dan para ahli bela diri mematikan yang semuanya berebut kekuasaan.

programme.title: Ep13: Dimitar Berbatov: Mun 10/11 : Rewind
programme.desc: One of the most elegant players ever to grace the beautiful game, Dimitar Berbatov reached his peak in the red of Manchester United. The Bulgarian recalls his journey, from humble beginnings to becoming a Premier League champion and Golden Boot winner.

programme.title: Ep04: Hassan Kachloul: My Southampton Years : Rewind
programme.desc: Hassan Kachloul was the first ever Moroccan player to grace the Premier League. Arriving at Southampton in 1998, he quickly became a fan favourite, helping the club to the "Great Escape" in 1999. He recalls the key matches and moments from his Saints career, including the unforgettable final game at The Dell.

programme.title: Ep13: Adam Lallana: My Premier League Years : Rewind
programme.desc: From the depths of League One to becoming a Premier League and European champion, Adam Lallana emerged as one of English football's standout talents of the 2010s. The midfielder recalls his most memorable matches for Southampton and Liverpool.

programme.title: Ep05: (Subbed) Diogo Jota : PL Stories
programme.desc: One year on from the tragic death of Diogo Jota and his brother Andre in a car accident, this deeply emotional PL Stories show celebrates the life of one of football's most loved figures. Through interviews with friends, teammates and coaches from Portugal to the Premier League, we look back on Jota's journey, the impact he had on those around him, and the legacy he left behind both on and off the pitch.

programme.title: Ep03: Robbie Fowler : 1-To-11

programme.title: Ep02: Kai Havertz : The Big Interview
programme.desc: As a young boy cheering from the terraces of his hometown club, Alemannia Aachen, Kai Havertz fell in love with a striker by the name of Erik Meijer. In this Extended version of the first Masterclass of the new season, Havertz' footballing icon surprises him at training, before the two share tricks of the trade on the art of forward play, recreating some of the Arsenal striker's best goals.

programme.title: Ep17: Granit Xhaka : PL Stories
programme.desc: From his family's courageous journey in search of a better future to becoming one of Europe's most respected midfielders, this is the story of Granit Xhaka. We chart his rise through the game, the highs and lows of a career that tested his resilience, and the turbulent relationship with Arsenal supporters that ultimately became one of football's greatest redemption stories. Now in love with the game again at Sunderland, Xhaka's story proves that perseverance can define a legacy as much as success

programme.title: Ep09: Kevin Phillips: My Sunderland Years : Rewind
programme.desc: Kevin Phillips remembers the unforgettable 1999/00 season, when he took the Premier League by storm with 30 goals for Sunderland - a tally that made him the top scorer in European football that campaign.

programme.title: Knockouts!: Mosley Vs Floyd
programme.desc: Acara utama dalam episode ini adalah pertarungan kelas welter yang sangat dinanti-nantikan yang menampilkan Floyd Mayweather, Jr. dan "Sugar" Shane Mosley. Pertarungan yang menghasilkan pendapatan sebesar $78 juta ini merupakan perebutan gelar pertama bagi Mayweather sejak ia kembali dari masa pensiunnya yang pertama. Juga ada dalam kartu pertandingan, petinju kelas berat Bermane Stiverne dan juara dunia dua divisi Marcos Maidana.

programme.title: Bipolar Rock N' Roller S1, Ep 3
programme.desc: Kisah nyata dan tak tergoyahkan tentang perjuangan Mauro Ranallo selama puluhan tahun melawan Gangguan Afektif Bipolar. Sebagai pengisi suara WWE dan Showtime Championship Boxing, Ranallo telah mengisi beberapa acara olahraga terbesar dalam sejarah - sembari bertarung dalam pertarungan epiknya dengan kesehatan mentalnya sendiri. Ikuti perjalanannya dalam serial 3 bagian ini, saat ia melawan stigma di balik masalah kesehatan mental dan menyoroti bagaimana rasanya menjadi yang teratas dalam industri ini meskipun rintangan yang tampaknya tidak dapat diatasi. Disutradarai oleh Haris Usanovic dengan penampilan dari Floyd Mayweather Jr. dan Conor McGregor. Episode 3 dari 3.

Dalam episode ini, kita melihat yang terbaik dari Grand Slam Judo dari Baku dan petarung peringkat dua dunia, Michael Korrell, berbicara tentang judo.

programme.title: AfterDeath
programme.desc: Akibat tragedi yang terjadi di klub malam, lima orang korban tewas terbangun di sebuah pantai. Takut dan bingung, mereka mencoba memahami berbagai hal dan bertanya-tanya apakah mereka sungguh sedang berada di neraka.

programme.title: The Great War
programme.desc: Pada hari-hari terakhir Perang Dunia Pertama, sekelompok tentara AS dikirim ke belakang garis musuh untuk menyelamatkan sebuah peleton yang tersesat.

programme.title: Riot
programme.desc: Polisi Jack Stone merampok bank mafia Rusia dan berakhir di penjara yang sama dengan bos mafia yang membunuh istri Jack. Seorang narapidana membantunya dan begitu pula seorang reporter. Banyak perkelahian.

programme.title: CSI S7, Ep 5
programme.desc: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation Season 7 mengikuti Gil Grissom dan tim investigator forensiknya saat memeriksa bukti serta menyelidiki berbagai kasus kriminal di Las Vegas. Dengan menggabungkan analisis ilmiah, pengamatan yang teliti, dan pengalaman investigasi, mereka berusaha merekonstruksi kejadian, menemukan tersangka, dan mengungkap kebenaran di balik setiap kasus.

programme.title: Mission Impossible S2, Ep 25
programme.desc: Mission: Impossible Season 2 mengikuti tim Impossible Missions Force (IMF) yang dipimpin Jim Phelps dalam menjalankan berbagai misi rahasia melawan penjahat, mata-mata, dan organisasi berbahaya. Dengan strategi cerdik, penyamaran, teknologi, dan kerja sama yang terkoordinasi, para agen harus menyelesaikan misi yang tampaknya mustahil tanpa diketahui lawan sekaligus menjaga identitas mereka.

Sepanjang jalan, mereka bergabung dengan beberapa teman baru seorang penemu jenius bernama Clemont, adik perempuannya Bonnie, dan Serena, seorang Pelatih dalam perjalanan pertamanya. Ash segera mencoba menantang Gym di Lumiose City, tetapi tidak terlalu jauh sebelum robot mengusirnya! Di sela-sela pertarungan Gym, Ash dan teman-temannya akan menjelajahi wilayah unik ini, bertemu semua jenis Pokemon baru, dan mencari misteri Pokemon baru yang menarik!

programme.title: Pororo Season 7
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang petualangan Pororo dan teman-temannya yang tinggal di desa bersalju Porong Porong Forest, yang sering menghadapi tantangan serta mempelajari pelajaran praktis dan moral dalam setiap episode.

programme.title: Tayo The Little Bus
programme.desc: Di kota besar di mana berbagai kendaraan hidup bahagia bersama, bus kecil Tayo baru saja mulai mempelajari rutenya di kota. Ada banyak lagi yang harus dipelajari untuk Tayo. Tayo dan teman-temannya yang ramah, Rogi, Lani, dan Gani saling membantu untuk menjadi bus dewasa yang hebat.

programme.title: Tayo Creator Clip
programme.desc: Saat Tayo dan teman-temannya menjalani hari, lihatlah teman-teman baru yang mereka temui.

programme.title: Poyo Poyo Story Vending Machine
programme.desc: Mesin penjual cerita memompa semua jenis cerita menyenangkan dari Pororo. Tayo dan Titipo!

programme.title: Detektif Kubi
programme.desc: Rasa ingin tahu mendorong orang untuk belajar! Baru-baru ini, di Hutan Sinar Matahari, banyak hal aneh telah terjadi. Jadi orang-orang meminta bantuan Detektif Kubi. Detektif Kubi, bersama dengan teman-teman mudanya, menemukan petunjuk dalam permainan kata dan membantu teman-teman mereka di hutan untuk memecahkan kasus satu per satu.

programme.title: Morphle - English Season 7
programme.desc: Ikuti petualangan Mila yang berusia 5 tahun dan hewan peliharaan ajaibnya Morphle, yang dapat berubah menjadi apa pun yang diimpikan Mila!

programme.title: Poyo Poyo Video Calls

programme.title: Po-Stagram Season 2
programme.desc: Gambar apa yang akan diposkan Pororo dan teman-temannya di Postagram? Lihat semua foto dan lihat kembali semua kenangan indah bersama.

programme.title: Cocomelon English
programme.desc: Pelajari huruf, angka, suara binatang, dan lainnya dengan JJ dalam serial musik yang menghadirkan saat-saat menyenangkan dengan sajak anak-anak untuk seluruh keluarga

programme.title: Poyo Show
programme.desc: Rasakan kisah Pororo, Tayo dan Tittipo! Hari ini, apa yang akan terjadi pada teman-teman kita?

programme.title: Kertas Ajaib
programme.desc: Seri ini menyampaikan nilai-nilai persahabatan, keberanian, keyakinan dan pengampunan kepada anak-anak dan menceritakan kisah-kisah yang dialami Howie dan Landau di dasar laut. Howie, seorang penemu cilik dan Landau, seorang ahli pengetahuan kelautan, pergi ke laut dalam secara tidak sengaja. Mereka datang ke Kerajaan Merman dan terlibat dalam krisis besar di dunia laut.

programme.title: Sunan Kalijaga
programme.desc: Film ini menceritakan perjalanan R.M. Said dalam menjadi Sunan Kalijaga, salah satu dari sembilan Sunan yang dikenal dengan Wali Songo.

programme.title: Melodi Cinta Rhoma Irama
programme.desc: Rhoma jatuh cinta pada Ricca dan mereka telah merencanakan sebuah pernikahan. Namun, hubungan asmara mereka diusik oleh Herman, pria yang mencintai Ricca dan ingin menguasai harta ayah Ricca.

programme.title: Abdullah Dan Takeshi
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah tentang dua anak laki-laki yang tertukar saat lahir di sebuah rumah sakit di Jepang. Bayi keturunan Arab dibesarkan oleh keluarga Jepang, sedangkan bayi keturunan Jepang dibesarkan oleh keluarga Arab.

programme.title: Sang Pencerah
programme.desc: Kisah K.H. Ahmad Dahlan, pahlawan Indonesia yang berjuang membangun Muhammadiyah, namun harus menghadapi penolakan masyarakat saat ia mencoba mengubah pandangan lama dan menanamkan cara pikir baru.

programme.title: Jin & Jun
programme.desc: Setelah dihajar para pengganggu, seorang siswa SMA yang putus asa bertemu dengan jin yang dapat membalikkan keberuntungannya - dan hartanya.

programme.title: Kuntilanak 3
programme.desc: Sekelompok anak muda menjelajahi hutan angker untuk mencari teman-teman mereka yang hilang. Di tengah perjalanan, mereka bertemu seorang wanita misterius yang menuju desa mistis demi menemukan cara menghentikan kutukan kelam yang menjeratnya.

programme.title: 100% Halal
programme.desc: Saat ia baru belajar memupuk cinta, Anisa Santosa, yang baru saja menikah muda dengan Putra Alfatih, suami pilihan ayahnya, Ilham Santosa.

programme.title: Jamila Dan Sang Presiden (IMC)
programme.desc: Jamila, terdakwa kasus pembunuhan seorang pejabat, menolak mengajukan grasi kepada presiden. Konflik dengan sang presiden, percekcokan dengan sipir penjara, dan tekanan pihak lain semakin membuat Jamila terpuruk.

programme.title: Jatuh Cinta Lagi (IMC)
programme.desc: Film ini menceritakan kisah cinta dua pengacara dengan sifat yang saling bertolak belakang. Mereka dipertemukan saat menangani kasus perceraian perebutan hak asuh anak dengan klien masing-masing.

programme.title: Sunan Kalijaga & Syech S. Jenar

Dipandu Oleh Tiga Host Utama Yaitu Komandan Zack, Bro Dim, Dan Miss Binal, Setiap Episodenya Juga Menghadirkan Berbagai Cameo Menarik Seperti Tahanan, Petugas Kebersihan, Hingga Karakter Unik Lainnya Yang Menambah Keseruan. programme.desc: Pensiunnya Bahar (pemimpin preman) dan kekacauan yang terjadi di wilayah kekuasaannya setelah ia menyerahkan urusan pada tangan kanannya, Muslihat, yang kemudian mencoba mengambil alih, memicu konflik dengan anak buah seperti Jamal dan Komar, memaksa Bahar turun tangan lagi untuk menyelesaikan masalah dan mengembalikan ketertiban, seperti kasus tanah di kampung dan penahanan Jamal.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Pagi : Terlanjur Mencintaimu Arumi (Rr)
programme.desc: Arumi, seorang barista keliling pekerja keras, menikah dengan Rendi, namun kemudian mengetahui bahwa pria itu sudah beristri dan hanya memanfaatkannya demi mendapatkan pewaris. programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Pagi : Mencintaimu Sekali Lagi Arini (Rr)
programme.desc: Arini, seorang penata rias sukses yang digemari para selebritas papan atas, mengalami patah hati saat memergoki kekasihnya berselingkuh dengan sahabatnya sendiri. Sempat kehilangan kepercayaan pada cinta, ia bertemu dengan Lingga yang perlahan memikat hatinya. Namun, masalah muncul ketika Emil, saudara laki-laki Lingga, juga jatuh hati padanya.

programme.title: Mencintaimu Sekali Lagi Arini

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia - Terikat Janji Selamanya
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia - Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua saudara perempuan bernama Andien dan Elsa. Keduanya tidak menyadari bahwa mereka sama-sama mencintai pria yang sama, yaitu Nino. Hubungan yang sudah renggang di antara mereka semakin memburuk setelah Elsa mengetahui bahwa Nino berencana menikahi Andien. Setelah menikah, Elsa memfitnah Andien hingga diceraikan Nino. Ditengah luka tersebut Andien bertemu dengan Aldebaran yang sengaja mendekati Andien untuk membalas dendam adiknya. Namun dengan kebaikan hati Andien, perlahan Aldebaran melihat kebenaran dan mulai jatuh cinta pada Andien

programme.title: Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin

programme.title: Ternyata Ini Cinta (RCTI)

programme.desc: Risya hidup dalam pernikahan yang penuh kontrol dan kekerasan, terjebak dalam ketakutan yang tak pernah ia pilih, dengan Niko. Saat suaminya berselingkuh dengan Wida, Risya perlahan menemukan harapan dan keberanian untuk bangkit berkat dukungan dari seorang pria yang juga instruktur yoganya, Anjas. programme.title: John Wick

programme.desc: Dua sahabat, mantan biksu Shaolin, berpisah saat mereka berhadapan dengan pemberontakan yang sedang berlangsung melawan pemerintah. Yang satu ambisius dan bangkit menjadi komandan militer yang kuat, sementara temannya yang dikhianati mempelajari teknik Tai Chi yang tenang.

programme.title: They Call Me Trinity
programme.desc: Seorang penembak ulung yang malas dan tidak biasa bersama saudara laki-lakinya yang gemuk dan gemar mencuri kuda berusaha melindungi sebuah permukiman Mormon dari seorang mayor yang ingin merebut tanah, seorang bandit Meksiko, dan anak buah mereka.

programme.title: Shaolin Vs Evil Dead 2

Gejolak sosial tersebut dipadukan dengan konflik moral pribadi Sai Yuk tentang bagaimana menyesuaikan diri dengan rezim persaudaraan yang kaku, dan di samping itu, menyelesaikan kehidupan cintanya yang rumit, dengan dua calon istri.

programme.title: Suka Ngeri Kalau Ingat...
programme.desc: FTV SCTV Suka Ngeri Kalau Inget Jagoan di Hati adalah berkisah tentang pasangan muda bernama Lisa (Ika Dihardjo) dan Yoga (Hardi Fadhillah). Di sana keduanya berlatar belakang dari keluarga yang sederhana. Ternyata Yoga disukai oleh seorang gadis cantik bernama Dita, begitu pula dengan Lisa yang disukai oleh seorang lelaki tampan, yang bahkan yang membuat Yoga berkali-kali jealous.

programme.title: FTV Pagi: Honestly Gue Tuh Suka Sama Dia, But She Can'T With Me
programme.desc: Film televisi yang mengangkat kisah romantisme kehidupan dengan konflik yang menarik. Tayang setiap hari.

programme.title: Honestly Gue Tuh Suka Sama Dia
programme.desc: Jamilah nganterin Enyak kondangan tapi di tengah jalan, ada pedagang yang diancam preman, bahkan sampai dihajar karena tak mau kasih setoran. Jamilah turun menolong karena ulah preman itu bikin jalanan macet. Enyak sempat ngomel karena mau kondangan tapi jiwa corsa Jamilah sebagai pendekar tak bisa dihentikan. Jamilah berkelahi melawan preman yang jumlahnya empat orang karena mereka memang gerombolan tukang palak. Untungnya Hafizah dan Annisa ada di sekitar situ, jadi ikutan menolong.

programme.title: Liputan 6 Siang (L)
programme.desc: Program berita yang menyajikan kumpulan liputan aktual dari dalam dan luar negeri.

programme.title: Samudra Cinta
programme.desc: Kisah bermula di dalam rumah sederhana Rusdi dan Bi Lila melakukan kesalahan dalam hubungan yang terlarang kemudian melahirkan bayi mungil bernama Cinta. meskipun terlahir dari seorang wanita penghibur Cinta beruntung bertemu dengan Samudra yang tulus sayang kepadanya. Dibintangi oleh Rangga Azof, Mischa Chandrawinta, Dylan Car, Cut Syifa, Angela Gilsha, Ben Kasyafani, Haico Van der Veken, dan lain lainnya

programme.title: Samudra Cinta
programme.desc: Cerita bermula di sebuah rumah sederhana. Rusdi bersama istrinya, Novi, dan ketiga anak mereka, Andra, Novan, dan Vina, sedang berbincang di ruang tamu sambil menonton televisi. Karena Vina tidak bisa tidur, Novi meminta Rusdi mematikan televisi. Saat itulah, mereka mendengar suara tangisan bayi yang seolah berasal dari depan rumah. Karena penasaran, Rusdi dan Novi akhirnya menidurkan Vina di dalam boks bayi, lalu keluar untuk memeriksa keadaan. Saat sampai di depan rumah, Novi dan Rusdi sangat terkejut melihat Lila sedang menggendong seorang bayi. Lila memohon kepada Rusdi untuk merawat anak kandungnya yang bernama Cinta.

programme.title: Istri Satu-Satunya
programme.desc: Istri Satu-Satunya adalah serial drama Indonesia tentang seorang wanita muda yang menyamar menjadi asisten rumah tangga (ART) di rumah suami ibunya untuk mengungkap rahasia masa lalu. Saksikan setiap hari pukul 16.00 WIB.

programme.title: Istri Satu-Satunya
programme.desc: Soraya menyamar sebagai asisten rumah tangga di rumah pria kaya dari masa lalunya yang bernama Pierre. Aksi ini ia lakukan demi membongkar rahasia kelam masa lalu keluarganya, dibantu oleh Mario di tengah konflik keluarga yang rumit.

programme.title: Putri Pewaris
programme.desc: Sinetron Putri Pewaris mengisahkan Aina, perempuan sederhana yang ternyata pewaris sah perusahaan VOLTZ setelah masa lalu keluarganya terungkap. Saksikan setiap hari pukul 17.00 WIB

programme.title: Putri Pewaris
programme.desc: Aina, mahasiswi sekaligus SPG, tak sengaja berkonflik dengan Darel setelah mengunggah aksinya yang viral di media sosial. Tanpa mereka sadari, Darel adalah anak Ferdi, pria yang merebut perusahaan sekaligus membunuh ayah Aina 20 tahun lalu. Perseteruan Aina dan Darel semakin rumit setelah sebuah kejadian membuat mereka nyaris dinikahkan, hingga kebencian perlahan berubah menjadi cinta. Namun, akankah cinta mereka bertahan ketika rahasia kelam kedua keluarga mulai terungkap?

programme.title: Cinta Seluas Samudra
programme.desc: Sinetron Cinta Seluas Samudra bercerita tentang pernikahan palsu yang terpaksa dijalani Andrian dengan asisten rumah tangganya, Maya, demi menyelamatkan nama baik keluarga pasca-kaburnya sang pengantin asli, perlahan menumbuhkan cinta tulus yang diuji oleh intrik balas dendam. Saksikan setiap hari pukul 18.25 WIB.

programme.title: Cinta Seluas Samudra
programme.desc: Maya terjebak dalam pernikahan palsu dengan Andrian, pewaris konglomerat yang perlahan jatuh cinta padanya. Namun, dendam Hana membawa Maya ke jurang dan membuatnya dinyatakan tewas. Saat Maya ternyata masih hidup dan berada di tangan Roni, sebuah konspirasi membuatnya percaya bahwa Andrian telah mengkhianatinya.

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain
programme.desc: Rasa sakit dan cinta di ingatakanku akan terus kekal. Dan Sekarang, cinta itu kembali dengan wajah yang lain..? Wajah Cinta Yang lain dibintangi oleh Dinda Kirana, Ibrahim Risyad, Oka Antara, Aulia Sarah, Andi Anissa, dan Andri Mashadi.

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain
programme.desc: Sebuah pengkhianatan mengubah hidup Asti untuk selamanya. Kehilangan wajah, keluarga, dan kehidupan yang selama ini ia percaya, Asti bangkit dengan identitas baru untuk membongkar konspirasi yang menghancurkan hidupnya. Di balik setiap kebenaran yang terungkap, ia harus memilih antara membalas dendam atau memperjuangkan masa depan anak yang menjadi satu-satunya alasan ia bertahan hidup.

programme.title: Biarkan Hati Bicara
programme.desc: Mimpi bahagia Arina (Febby Rastanty) berubah jadi ancaman saat hari pernikahannya bersama Reno (Randy Jhon) dihancurkan oleh Fico (Rangga Azof) yang dikuasai dendam keluarga! saksikan kisahnya dalam sinetron terbaru biarkan hati bicara

programme.title: Biarkan Hati Bicara
programme.desc: Sejak kecil, Arina hidup dalam bayang-bayang masa lalu yang kelam. Saat ia akhirnya menemukan harapan melalui pernikahan dengan pria yang dicintainya, takdir justru mempertemukannya dengan sebuah pengkhianatan yang mengubah hidupnya. Terjebak dalam keluarga yang dipenuhi dendam, rahasia, dan kebencian, Arina harus mengungkap kebenaran sebelum semuanya terlambat.

programme.title: FTV Primetime: Ditinggal Nikah Aku Rapopo
programme.desc: Film televisi yang mengangkat kisah romantisme kehidupan dengan konflik yang menarik. Tayang setiap hari.

programme.title: Ditinggal Nikah Aku Rapopo
programme.desc: Sama-sama ditinggal nikah sama pacarnya membuat Valerie Tiffanka dan Rizky Alatas bertemu. Udah berasa cocok tapi masih kepingin balikan sama mantan.

programme.title: Arafta: Terbelenggu Takdir
programme.desc: Ates terjebak antara obsesi balas dendam dan cintanya pada Mercan. Saat niat menghancurkan berubah jadi rasa, sanggupkah ia memilih kedamaian?

programme.title: Best Match Pegadaian Championship 2026/27

programme.title: Islam Penuh Cinta
programme.desc: Islam Penuh Cinta di Sin Po TV adalah program tausiyah agama islam, yang menampilkan Islam sebagai agama rahmat bagi semesta alam. Memberikan pemahaman konsep cinta dari sudut pandang Islam yang terdapat dalam Al-quran dan Hadist. Selain memeberikan ilmu ke islaman, Islam penuh cinta juga mengajak pemirsa memahami nilai-nilai persatuan, persaudaraan, keadilan, dan kepedulian serta menumbuhkan cinta serta damai di hati setiap orang.

programme.title: Menyapa Indonesia Pagi
programme.desc: Menyapa Indonesia Pagi di Sin Po TV adalah program berita dan informasi yang mengawali hari pemirsa dengan berita terkini. programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake's Berry Bitty Adventures
programme.desc: The girls plan a formal afternoon lawn party tea to inaugurate their new dog park. Plum is in charge of decorations, Cherry music, and Strawberry snacks. There's even a giant, dog-shaped ice sculpture. As the girls get dressed, Raspberry puts the finishing touches on the high-fashion hats that will accompany their beautiful gowns. At last everything is ready. But when the gate opens... the puppies back away!

There's even a giant, dog-shaped ice sculpture. As the girls get dressed, Raspberry puts the finishing touches on the high-fashion hats that will accompany their beautiful gowns. At last everything is ready. But when the gate opens... the puppies back away!

programme.title: Dead Awake
programme.desc: Kate Bowman is a by-the-books social worker who is investigating a series of mysterious deaths. Each victim suffered from sleep paralysis, a frightening ailment that immobilizes its victims as they dream. Kate is approached by an unorthodox doctor who warns of an evil entity that haunts people in their sleep. She brushes aside his admonition, but when a terrifying entity begins to haunt Kate's friends and loved ones, she must fight to stay awake to stop the nightmare she's unleashed.

programme.title: Curtains
programme.desc: Six young actresses auditioning for a movie role at a remote mansion are targeted by a mysterious masked murderer.

programme.title: Hush (2016) [B&W Shush Cut] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: Chopping Mall [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight teenagers are trapped after hours in a high-tech shopping mall and pursued by three murderous security robots out of control.

programme.title: Flight 666
programme.desc: Passengers on an international flight are attacked by unseen forces. As they fight to stay alive, they realize who is controlling the attacks.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 2
programme.desc: Renegade police officer Matthew Cordell (Robert Z'Dar) once roamed the streets of New York City unleashing his murderous brand of vigilante justice upon its denizens before being struck down by good cop Jack Forrest (Bruce Campbell). Now, Forrest is eager to move on from those heinous events, but he is stopped short when a familiar killing spree begins. Though thought dead and gone, Cordell is back from the grave and ready to wreak his merciless havoc once more.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Swarmed
programme.desc: The residents of a small town find themselves battling a swarm of hornets that have been sprayed by a super pesticide.

programme.title: Crocodile
programme.desc: A group of friends goes on a boat trip - but their joyful weekend turns into horror when a giant killer crocodile, searching for its stolen eggs, picks off anyone who gets in its way.

programme.title: Maneater
programme.desc: Townspeople must venture deep into the woods to save their isolated town from an escaped Bengal tiger.

programme.title: Chopping Mall [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight teenagers are trapped after hours in a high-tech shopping mall and pursued by three murderous security robots out of control.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 3: Badge of Silence
programme.desc: Cop Katie Sullivan (Gretchen Becker) shoots two crooks who are robbing a store, and though she's also wounded in the process, reporters cast her as a trigger-happy rogue. Devious police department bosses, hoping to get rid of a public relations problem, plan to kill Sullivan. But Matt Cordell (Robert Z'Dar), a dead cop who's just been resurrected, takes a liking to Sullivan and is determined to mow down her enemies before a police detective, Sean McKinney (Robert Davi), can stop him.

programme.title: Shark Attack 3: Megalodon
programme.desc: In the third installment of the "Shark Attack" saga, marine researchers make a startling discovery: the most menacing beast that ever ruled these waters is still alive.

programme.title: Octopus
programme.desc: A Russian sub is sunk while en route to Havana. The hold is breached and barrels full of some mysterious substance tumble out. Later, reports of a killer octopus surface.

programme.title: Spiders 2
programme.desc: Alexandra (Stephanie Niznik) and Jason (Greg Cromer) are a married couple whose yacht fails to withstand a storm at sea. They're saved from the stormy waters by Capt. Bigelow (Daniel Quinn) and his crew, who man a cargo ship. Jason is heavily drugged by the ship's doctor, Gerbac (Richard Moll), and realizes something is amiss when he comes across corpses. Meanwhile, Gerbac is working on a dangerous scientific experiment using spider eggs, which he hopes to implant in Jason's body.

programme.title: A Fantastic Fear Of Everything [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A crime novelist whose research on Victorian serial killers has turned him into a paranoid wreck must confront his worst fears when a film executive takes a sudden interest in his movie script.

programme.title: Maneater
programme.desc: Townspeople must venture deep into the woods to save their isolated town from an escaped Bengal tiger.

programme.title: Eraserhead [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Henry (John Nance) resides alone in a bleak apartment surrounded by industrial gloom. When he discovers that an earlier fling with Mary X (Charlotte Stewart) left her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a decidedly strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing. Other characters, including a disfigured lady who lives inside a radiator, inhabit the building and add to Henry's troubles.

programme.title: The Exorcist III: Legion (Director's Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Police Lt. Kinderman (George C. Scott) notices similarities between his current murder investigation and the methods used by the Gemini killer (Brad Dourif) who was executed 15 years before. He soon discovers a hospitalized mental patient (Jason Miller) claiming to be the dead serial killer, but who looks uncannily like a priest Kinderman knew who died during an exorcism. As more bodies are found, Kinderman looks for connections between the two supposedly dead men.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: A Bucket Of Blood
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries her hand at being an artist in a variety of mediums. Also, Breather presents the Mistress of the Dark with The Publisher's Wet T-Shirt Contest Award.

programme.title: Black Christmas [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: As winter break begins, a group of sorority sisters, including Jess (Olivia Hussey) and the often inebriated Barb (Margot Kidder), begin to receive anonymous, lascivious phone calls. Initially, Barb eggs the caller on, but stops when he responds threateningly. Soon, Barb's friend Clare (Lynne Griffin) goes missing from the sorority house, and a local adolescent girl is murdered, leading the girls to suspect a serial killer is on the loose. But no one realizes just how near the culprit is.

programme.title: Dominion: Prequel To The Exorcist [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Haunted by terrible acts the Nazis forced him to participate in, the disenchanted Father Lankester Merrin focuses his energies on helping with an archaeological dig in the northern part of Kenya. There, the crew uncovers a church that predates Christian missions into the area, but the discovery also causes strange events to start occurring -- including physical changes to a young, disabled boy, whom Merrin grows to suspect has been possessed by a demon.

programme.title: Hollow Creek
programme.desc: Trying to find inspiration for his next horror novel, Blake retreats to the Appalachian Mountains with his mistress, Angelica. When she disappears, Blake becomes a prime suspect.

programme.desc: Four friends go into Australia's outback to explore the site where a violent family met its end at the hands of an angry mob. Despite all warnings, they persist in their terrifying adventure.

programme.desc: A team of TV ghost hunters travel to investigate a haunted house surrounded by rumors. Upon their arrival, they find a foreboding house with a mind of its own. With Corin Nemec ("Stargate SG-1") and Charisma Carpenter ("Angel").

programme.desc: Ten years have passed since the brutal murder of two teenage girls by a psychopath named Jonah. He escapes from the mental institution and returns to his old haunt, an amusement park with an attraction called "Dark Ride." Meanwhile, six friends on a road trip board the ride, not knowing of the deadly plans Jonah has in store.

programme.title: Duchess
programme.desc: Duchess, a small-time crook, tries to enter the treacherous underworld of diamond trafficking and ends up left for dead when a deal goes wrong. Determined to seek retribution she launches into an unwavering pursuit for vengeance.

programme.title: Backtrack
programme.desc: While fixing a flat tire, artist Anne Benton (Jodie Foster) sees a mob killing. She reports the murder to the local police, but they are unable to protect her from Mafia don Lino Avoca (Vincent Price), who orders hitman Milo (Dennis Hopper) to track her down and kill her. Anne changes her identity, moves to Seattle and builds a new life, while Milo, preparing for his mission, becomes increasingly obsessed with her. When he finally finds Anne, Milo needs to decide what his next move will be.

programme.title: Earth Girls Are Easy
programme.desc: In this musical comedy, Valerie is dealing with her philandering fiancé, Ted, when she finds that a trio of aliens have crashed their spaceship into her swimming pool. Once the furry beings are shaved at her girlfriend's salon, the women discover three handsome men underneath. After absorbing the native culture via television, the spacemen are ready to hit the dating scene in the 1980s Los Angeles.

programme.title: She-Devil
programme.desc: Housewife and mother Ruth Patchett (Roseanne Barr), an overweight and unkempt woman, can seem to do nothing to make her husband, Bob (Ed Begley Jr.), happy. When he becomes embroiled in an affair with romance novelist Mary Fisher (Meryl Streep), Patchett does all she can to ignore it until Bob finally leaves her for Fisher. Bent on revenge, Patchett begins an intricate undertaking that will lead to the destruction of all that Bob holds dear -- and she also has plans for Fisher while she's at it.

programme.title: Elvira's Haunted Hills

However, Sebastian gets more than he bargained for as he attempts to woo Annette into his bed.

programme.title: The Messengers

Jess must warn her disbelieving family before it is too late to save them.

Now he must go home for the funeral of his mother, who died under strange circumstances. While in his hometown, Jon's daughter, Michelle (Hilary Swank), makes friends with some of the local girls as well as someone named Tony Reno (Alexis Arquette), who resembles and has the same name as one of the boys her father killed.

programme.title: The Inspection
programme.desc: A young, gay Black man with few options for his future decides to join the Marines, willing to do whatever it takes to prove himself to his estranged mother and triumph in a system that would otherwise cast him aside. However, when Francis starts to sleepwalk and experience night terrors, the couple soon discover they're being haunted by a ghost that wants to punish them for their sins.

programme.title: Fittest on Earth: Final Showdown in Madtown
programme.desc: A diverse group of elite male and female athletes competes for the coveted title of Fittest on Earth in the 2023 CrossFit Games.

programme.title: The Company
programme.desc: Loretta "Ry" Ryan (Neve Campbell) is an aspiring ballerina performing with the renowned Joffrey Ballet in Chicago. As she struggles with the demands of being a dancer, she also begins a relationship with the handsome Josh (James Franco), who isn't involved in that insular world. The drama looks at the lives of others in the company, including the passionate artistic director, Alberto Antonelli (Malcolm McDowell), and features many actual Joffrey dancers.

programme.title: Communion
programme.desc: A novelist's (Christopher Walken) wife (Lindsay Crouse) and son (Joel Carlson) see him changed by an apparent encounter with aliens in the mountains.

programme.title: Boyka: Undisputed 4
programme.desc: Boyka accidentally kills an opponent in the ring, forcing him to question everything he's worked for. When he finds out his opponent's widow is in trouble, he becomes her champion in a series of seemingly impossible fights.

programme.title: Inland Empire
programme.desc: Nikki (Laura Dern), an actress, takes on a role in a new film, and because her husband (Peter J. Lucas) is very jealous, her co-star Devon (Justin Theroux) gets a warning not to make any romantic overtures -- especially since the characters they play are having an affair. Both actors learn that the project is a remake of an unfinished film in which the stars were murdered.

programme.title: Day of the Dead
programme.desc: The living dead regroup above while humans (Lori Cardille, Terry Alexander, Joseph Pilato) sweat it out below in a Florida missile silo.

programme.title: Red Riding: 1974
programme.desc: When a young girl goes missing, Yorkshire Post crime reporter Eddie Dunford (Andrew Garfield) becomes intrigued by a series of mysterious child murders that date back several years and mirror to the current case. He faces stiff opposition from the local police and his editor, Bill (John Henshaw). Eddie's troubles escalate when he becomes involved with a moody widow (Rebecca Hall) who has a mysterious connection to wealthy developer John Dawson (Sean Bean).

programme.title: Itsy Bitsy
programme.desc: An ancient mysterious relic unleashes a giant prehistoric spider that terrorizes a single mother and her two children in their new house.

programme.title: Fast Vengeance
programme.desc: Determined to find those responsible for his brother's death, a man infiltrates the dangerous and high-stakes world of underground motorcycle racing.

programme.title: Midnight Sun
programme.desc: Sheltered since childhood, 17-year-old Katie Price lives with a life-threatening sensitivity to sunlight. Her world opens up after dark when she ventures out to play her guitar for random travelers. One night, Katie encounters Charlie, a young man she's secretly admired for years. As fate leads to a budding romance, Katie desperately tries to hide her condition from her unsuspecting new beau.

programme.title: Dreamscape
programme.desc: Selfish teen Alex Gardner (Dennis Quaid) is coerced into joining a government project in which psychics like him are trained to enter others' dreams. He starts learning to use his abilities to do good, but before long, a new official, Bob Blair (Christopher Plummer), seizes control of the project. A writer (George Wendt) helps Alex uncover Blair's true motives, which involve assassination via dreams. Soon, only Alex and a beautiful scientist (Kate Capshaw) stand in the way of something terrible.

programme.title: Freejack
programme.desc: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place.

programme.title: Guns of Redemption
programme.desc: Searching for redemption, a mysterious gunslinger with a violent past tries to save a young woman from vicious men who run a traveling brothel.

programme.title: The Decline of Western Civilization Part III
programme.desc: In this documentary, filmmaker Penelope Spheeris captures the life of Los Angeles "gutter punks": homeless teenagers who prefer anarchy and chaos to organized society. Many of the film's subjects come from abusive households and have developed alcohol and drug problems. While living on the streets, they must panhandle, squat in abandoned apartment buildings and fight off skinheads to survive. The film also includes performances by several notable Los Angeles punk bands.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: The Lady Vanishes
programme.desc: In the years before World War II, zany heiress Amanda Kelly (Cybill Shepherd) travels by train to Switzerland. While passing through Germany, she meets a sweet elderly lady, Miss Froy (Angela Lansbury), who suddenly vanishes. Distraught, Amanda questions her fellow passengers who claim that the woman was never there. Unsure if it's all in her mind or if there's a more sinister plot afoot, Amanda teams up with photographer Robert Condon (Elliott Gould) to discover the truth.

programme.title: Shade
programme.desc: Tiffany (Jamie Foxx), Charlie (Gabriel Byrne) and Vernon (Thandie Newton) are con artists looking to up the ante from their typical scams. They figure a good way of doing this is taking down Dean "The Dean" Stevens (Dina Merrill), a well-known cardsharp, in a rigged game. However, they first need enough money to enter a game with Stevens, so they decide to strike a deal with fellow crook Larry Jennings (Stuart Townsend) to scam a local gangster -- which turns out to be a bad idea.

programme.title: Class of 1984
programme.desc: A high-school music teacher (Perry King) hunts a hoodlum student (Timothy Van Patten) for attacking his wife (Merrie Lynn Ross).

programme.title: Drugstore June
programme.desc: June is a wannabe influencer who's juggling multiple problems: her parents want her to move out, her ex-boyfriend accuses her of stalking him, and two detectives think she may be involved in the robbery of a local pharmacy.

programme.title: Villains
programme.desc: Amateur criminals stumble upon a dark secret in a sadistic couple's home.

programme.title: C.H.U.D.
programme.desc: Photographer George Cooper (John Heard) is documenting the lives of subterranean homeless people, a population that has mysteriously dwindled. After receiving information from a reporter, George becomes aware of a conspiracy theory about cannibalistic monsters lurking in the sewers. He teams up with the reporter, a policeman (Christopher Curry) and a priest (Daniel Stern) to fight two battles: one against the cannibals and the other against a corrupt government official.

programme.title: All I See Is You
programme.desc: Gina is a beautiful young woman who's still haunted by the accident that took her sight years earlier. Living in Bangkok with her husband, James, she undergoes a cutting-edge operation that restores the vision to her right eye. Now that Gina can see again, she slowly starts to realize that her newfound independence makes James feel jealous, threatened and insecure.

programme.title: The Man Who Knew Too Much
programme.desc: On a family vacation in Switzerland, Bob (Leslie Banks) and his wife, Jill (Edna Best), become friendly with a man staying in their hotel. When the stranger is assassinated in their presence, the vacation turns dangerous. Before dying, the stranger passes along a secret to Jill. Then, to keep the couple silent, a band of foreign assassins kidnaps their daughter. Offered no help by the police, Bob and Jill hunt for their daughter as they try to understand the information that they have.

programme.title: Coffee and Cigarettes
programme.desc: This 11-vignette film focuses on the human interactions that happen while partaking in the everyday indulgence of coffee and cigarettes. Featuring well-known actors and other artists as themselves or some version thereof, the film highlights the nuances and subtle hostilities that can be a part of seemingly normal conversations. Bill Murray waits on the Wu-Tang Clan, Iggy Pop and Tom Waits get on each other's nerves and Jack and Meg White of the White Stripes discuss Nikola Tesla.

programme.title: Red Riding: 1980
programme.desc: Six years after his first visit to Yorkshire, England, detective Peter Hunter (Paddy Considine) returns to look into the town's high murder rate. Though the deaths have been occurring with alarming regularity over the years, the police have done little to find the killer, who's now known as the Yorkshire Ripper. As Hunter discovers mysterious irregularities in the case, he realizes corrupt police officers (David Morrissey, Warren Clarke) are doing everything they can to stop his investigation.

programme.title: Shadow
programme.desc: To finally achieve victory over a rival kingdom, a brilliant general devises an intricate plan involving his wife, a look-alike and two kings.

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: A vengeful crime boss forms an unlikely partnership with a detective, to catch the elusive serial killer who attacked him.

programme.title: Seobok: Project Clone
programme.desc: A former secret agent, Ki-heon, is living in seclusion due to trauma. When he meets a cloned human, Seo Bok, his restless journey begins.

programme.title: Kung Fu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Filmmakers showcase the dedication and struggles of kung fu stuntmen and action directors working in Hong Kong cinema during the 1960s-'80s.

programme.title: Special ID
programme.desc: An undercover cop (Donnie Yen) infiltrates one of China's most ruthless crime syndicates. He must risk everything to protect his family and his life after the boss (Collin Chou) vows to find and kill every traitor in his organization.

programme.title: Code of the Assassins
programme.desc: Trained by the best, a young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family's massacre years ago. Failing to complete his mission, he becomes a fugitive hunted by the government, rival assassin groups and other shadowy killers.

programme.title: Rise of the Legend
programme.desc: A powerful martial arts master (Eddie Peng) returns to the town where his father was murdered to take on a ruthless crime boss (Sammo Hung).

programme.title: Deliver Us From Evil
programme.desc: An assassin goes to Thailand in order to solve a kidnapping case and finds himself chased by a man whose sibling he killed.

programme.desc: A teenage delivery boy (Jay Chou) utilizes special driving skills to compete against other racers.

programme.title: Samurai Marathon
programme.desc: A spy has to win a race to prevent a shogunate from wrecking an alliance.

programme.title: Shocking Kung Fu of Huo's
programme.desc: Huo Zhenshan opens a school to promote Chinese martial arts 20 years after the Revolution of 1911.

programme.title: Railroad Tigers
programme.desc: A railroad worker and his ragtag group of freedom fighters find themselves on the wrong side of the tracks when they decide to ambush a heavily armed military train filled with desperately needed provisions. Unarmed and outnumbered, they must rely on their wits to battle an entire army.

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: Chinese martial arts student Chen Zhen is studying in Kyoto, Japan, when he learns his mentor has died in a match against Ryuichi Akutagawa. Returning home to the Japanese-occupied Shanghai of 1937, Chen challenges Ryuichi to a fight and easily defeats him. Concluding his master was set up, Chen has an autopsy performed. Meanwhile, word of his martial arts skill entices new students hoping to study with him, making his teacher's son, Huo Ting-An, jealous.

programme.title: Operation Mekong
programme.desc: Members of an international task force seek justice against the leader of an Asian drug cartel and his murderous henchmen.

programme.title: End of Days
programme.desc: With the millennium approaching, a series of disturbing signs suggests that Satan (Arnold Schwarzenegger) has returned to Earth and is walking the streets of New York City. It seems that Satan needs to find a woman who will bear his child, as the time for the arrival of the anti-Christ draws near.

programme.title: The Darkness
programme.desc: Peter Taylor (Kevin Bacon), his wife Bronny and their two children return to Los Angeles after a fun-filled vacation to the Grand Canyon. Strange events soon start to plague the family, including young son Michael's increasingly erratic behavior. The Taylors learn that Michael brought back some mysterious rocks that he discovered inside a cave. Unfortunately, something followed them home as the clan now find themselves in a battle with a supernatural force that preys on their worst fears.

programme.title: Blues Brothers 2000
programme.desc: The now-brotherless Ellwood Blues (Dan Aykroyd) is finally out of prison, attempting to reunite the old band and find a few new partners in crime (John Goodman), (J. Evan Bonifant). In this sequel to the original "Blues Brothers" comedy/musical, Ellwood battles the Chicago police, sings and dances his way out of numerous sticky situations, and manages to get the old band on the road for a hair-raising adventure.

programme.title: Bird on a Wire
programme.desc: Rick Jarmin (Mel Gibson) is put in witness protection after he helps the FBI bust drug dealer Eugene Sorenson (David Carradine). Fifteen years later, he is living with a new identity as a gas station attendant in Detroit. When an old flame named Marianne (Goldie Hawn) stops at the gas station and recognizes him, his cover gets blown. The recently released Sorenson finds out, and both Jarmin and Marianne have to flee across the country with the vengeful Sorenson in hot pursuit.

programme.title: Serial Mom
programme.desc: A seemingly perfect wife and mother (Kathleen Turner) from Baltimore gains celebrity status as a serial killer.

programme.title: Altered
programme.desc: Forever damaged by their stint as the scientific subjects of hostile alien creatures, a trio of alien-abduction survivors -- Otis (Michael C. Williams), Duke (Brad William Henke) and Cody (Paul McCarthy-Boyington) -- troll the wooded site of their disappearance, heavily armed, in search of their attackers. After wounding a violent alien in the woods, the three drag its dying body to the home of reclusive fellow abductee Wyatt (Adam Kaufman), barricade themselves in and prepare for the worst.

programme.title: White Noise
programme.desc: Architect Jonathan Rivers (Michael Keaton) is happily married to author Anna (Chandra West), but tragedy strikes when she is killed in an accident. Deep in grief, Jonathan hears from Raymond Price (Ian McNeice), who claims that he has intercepted messages from Anna via electronic voice phenomena. Jonathan eventually comes to believe Raymond's claims, but, as he is drawn further into investigating the phenomenon, a sinister supernatural presence invades his life.

programme.title: White Noise 2: The Light
programme.desc: A man's family is killed, but he survives -- barely. After recovering, he realizes that he has changed in some way: He now senses when someone is about to die. In his attempts to save people who are near death, he discovers there is a price to pay for interfering with the cosmos.

programme.title: The New Daughter
programme.desc: A single father (Kevin Costner) is puzzled by his daughter's (Ivana Baquero) weird behavior, which begins soon after he moves his family to a secluded woodland home.

programme.title: Mama
programme.desc: On the day that their parents die, sisters Lilly and Victoria vanish in the woods, prompting a frantic search by their Uncle Lucas (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) and his girlfriend, Annabel (Jessica Chastain). Five years later, miraculously, the girls are found alive in a decaying cabin, and Lucas and Annabel welcome them into their home. But as Annabel tries to reintroduce the children to a normal life, she finds that someone -- or something -- still wants to tuck them in at night.

programme.title: The Unborn
programme.desc: Plagued by nightmares and visitations from tortured ghosts, Casey Beldon turns to a spiritual adviser named Sendak for help. They discover a family curse that dates back to Nazi Germany: an evil spirit that can take over the body of anyone and is getting stronger with each possession, as it tries to gain full entrance to this world.

programme.title: The Forest
programme.desc: When her twin sister disappears in Japan, a young American named Sara becomes determined to find out what happened to her. Sara's investigation leads her to the legendary Aokigahara Forest, located at the base of Mount Fuji. Accompanied by expatriate Aiden, she enters the mysterious wilderness after being warned to "stay on the path." Her investigation plunges her into a dark world where the angry and tormented souls of the dead prey on those who dare to explore the forest.

programme.title: Dead Silence
programme.desc: After his wife meets a grisly end, Jamie Ashen (Ryan Kwanten) returns to their creepy hometown of Ravens Fair to unravel the mystery of her murder. Once there, he discovers the legend of Mary Shaw (Joan Heney), a murdered ventriloquist whose eerie presence still looms over the town. As he desperately digs for answers, Jamie encounters the curse that took his wife's life and threatens his own.

programme.title: Unfriended
programme.desc: One night, while teenagers Blaire, Mitch, Jess, Adam Ken and Val take part in an online group chat session, they are suddenly joined by a user known only as "Billie227." Thinking it's just a technical glitch, the friends carry on their conversation... until Blaire begins receiving messages from someone claiming to be Laura Barns, a classmate who killed herself exactly one year prior. As Blaire tries to expose Billie's identity, her friends are forced to confront their darkest secrets and lies.

programme.title: Black Christmas
programme.desc: Hawthorne College is quieting down for the holidays as students travel home to spend time with their families. But as Riley and her sorority sisters prepare to deck the halls with seasonal parties, a mysterious cloaked figure starts to leave a bloody trail throughout the campus. Refusing to become hapless victims, Riley and her friends decide to band together and fight back against the psychotic Christmas killer.

programme.title: Nocturnal Animals
programme.desc: A successful Los Angeles art-gallery owner's idyllic life is marred by the constant traveling of her handsome second husband. While he is away, she is shaken by the arrival of a manuscript written by her first husband, who she has not seen in years. The manuscript tells the story of a teacher who finds a trip with his family turning into a nightmare. As Susan reads the book, it forces her to examine her past and confront some dark truths.

programme.title: Children of Men
programme.desc: When infertility threatens mankind with extinction and the last child born has perished, a disillusioned bureaucrat (Clive Owen) becomes the unlikely champion in the fight for the survival of Earth's population; He must face down his own demons and protect the planet's last remaining hope from danger.

programme.title: Altered
programme.desc: Forever damaged by their stint as the scientific subjects of hostile alien creatures, a trio of alien-abduction survivors -- Otis (Michael C. Williams), Duke (Brad William Henke) and Cody (Paul McCarthy-Boyington) -- troll the wooded site of their disappearance, heavily armed, in search of their attackers. After wounding a violent alien in the woods, the three drag its dying body to the home of reclusive fellow abductee Wyatt (Adam Kaufman), barricade themselves in and prepare for the worst.

programme.title: Walk of Shame
programme.desc: Meghan (Elizabeth Banks) is an aspiring news anchor in the cutthroat world of Los Angeles television. After an audition for her dream job ends in failure, she goes out for an uncharacteristic night of partying. The next morning, she awakes in a stranger's bed and hears a phone message from her agent telling her the job is hers if she can make it across town by 5:00 pm. Stranded in an unknown area without money, phone or transportation, she races to the most important interview of her life.

programme.title: Trainwreck
programme.desc: Ever since her father drilled into her head that monogamy isn't realistic, magazine writer Amy has made promiscuity her credo. As much as she enjoys an uninhibited life free of commitment, Amy is really in a rut. While writing a profile about charming and successful sports doctor Aaron Conners, she finds herself actually falling in love for the first time, and what's more, Aaron seems to like her too. Amy starts to wonder if it's time to clean up her act.

programme.title: American Pie 2
programme.desc: After a year apart - attending different schools, meeting different people - the guys rent a beach house and vow to make this the best summer ever. As it turns out, whether that will happen or not has a lot to do with the girls. Between the wild parties, outrageous revelations and yes, a trip to band camp, they discover that times change and people change, but in the end, it's all about sticking together.

programme.title: Chinese Zodiac
programme.desc: A treasure hunter (Jackie Chan) and his team set out on a global quest to find a set of Chinese zodiac bronze heads that were stolen from a Beijing palace in the 19th century.

programme.title: Trespass
programme.desc: Firefighters Vince (Bill Paxton) and Don (William Sadler) venture into gang-infested territory to find gold that's been hidden inside an abandoned building. But when they witness a murder, they become the targets of crime lord King James (Ice-T) and his underling Savon (Ice Cube). Fortunately, the treasure hunters have kidnapped a bargaining chip: King James' half-brother, Lucky (Devoreaux White). But this might not be enough to get them -- and their gold -- out of the building intact.

programme.title: Smokin' Aces
programme.desc: Sleazy entertainer Buddy "Aces" Israel incurs the wrath of crime boss Primo Sparazza when he agrees to testify against the Las Vegas mob. Two FBI agents have the difficult task of protecting him from a motley assortment of bounty hunters, hit men and nefarious vixens who are converging on his Lake Tahoe encampment to rub him out and collect a hefty reward.

programme.title: They Live
programme.desc: Nada (Roddy Piper), a wanderer without meaning in his life, discovers a pair of sunglasses capable of showing the world the way it truly is. As he walks the streets of Los Angeles, Nada notices that both the media and the government are comprised of subliminal messages meant to keep the population subdued, and that most of the social elite are skull-faced aliens bent on world domination. With this shocking discovery, Nada fights to free humanity from the mind-controlling aliens.

programme.title: The Watcher
programme.desc: The Watcher is an exciting psychological thriller that takes a unique look into the minds of both a serial killer and the man who must, reluctantly, pursue him. In an almost Hitchcockian way, the film quickly introduces us to the killer, David Allen Griffin, played by Keanu Reeves, who for many years, preyed on lonely young women in the Los Angeles area. The story is set up to create a taut cat-and-mouse game between Griffin and FBI agent Joel Campbell.

programme.title: Captive State
programme.desc: After 10 years of extraterrestrial occupation, residents of Chicago must decide whether to continue to live under alien rule or support the resistance. When young Gabriel Drummond joins the insurgency, he soon finds himself under careful scrutiny from a shadowy figure who's trying to crush the rebellion and its plans for freedom.

programme.title: Fatale
programme.desc: After a wild one-night stand, a successful sports agent watches his perfect life slowly disappear when he discovers the sexy and mysterious woman he risked everything for is a determined police detective who entangles him in her latest investigation. As he desperately tries to put the pieces together, he falls deeper into her trap, risking his family, his career, and even his life.

programme.title: Alex Cross
programme.desc: Alex Cross (Tyler Perry) works as a detective/psychologist for the Detroit Police Department along with his lifelong friend, Tommy Kane (Edward Burns), and detective Monica Ashe (Rachel Nichols). Cross' latest case puts him on a collision course with Picasso (Matthew Fox), a cunning serial killer whose ultimate target is multinational industrialist Giles Mercier (Jean Reno). Cross must find a way inside Picasso's head not only to catch the killer but also to stem the violent urges Cross feels.

programme.title: Brooklyn's Finest
programme.desc: A drug operation changes the lives of three conflicted New York cops. Burned-out vet Eddie Dugan is close to retirement; narcotics cop Sal Procida faces the difficult task of caring for his large family on his ordinary salary. Undercover officer Clarence Tango Butler finds his loyalties beginning to shift toward a powerful drug dealer. Over seven chaotic days, the three men are drawn toward a fateful crime and destiny.

programme.title: Detroit
programme.desc: In the summer of 1967, rioting and civil unrest starts to tear apart the city of Detroit. Two days later, a report of gunshots prompts the Detroit Police Department, the Michigan State Police and the Michigan Army National Guard to search and seize an annex of the nearby Algiers Motel. Several policemen start to flout procedure by forcefully and viciously interrogating guests to get a confession. By the end of the night, three unarmed men are gunned down while several others are brutally beaten.

programme.title: Damaged
programme.desc: When a sadistic murderer surfaces in Scotland, terrified local authorities call on a Chicago detective who investigated a killing spree with the same horrific pattern five years earlier.

programme.title: Destroyer
programme.desc: As a young cop, Erin Bell went undercover to infiltrate a gang in the California desert -- with tragic results. Bell continues to work as a detective for the Los Angeles Police Department, but feelings of anger and remorse leave her worn-down and consumed by guilt. When the leader of that gang suddenly re-emerges, Erin embarks on an obsessive quest to find his former associates, bring him to justice and make peace with her tortured past.

programme.title: Divergent
programme.desc: Tris Prior lives in a futuristic world in which society is divided into five factions. As each person enters adulthood, he or she must choose a faction and commit to it for life. Tris chooses Dauntless -- those who pursue bravery above all else. However, her initiation leads to the discovery that she is a Divergent and will never be able to fit into just one faction. Warned that she must conceal her status, Tris uncovers a looming war which threatens everyone she loves.

programme.title: The Divergent Series: Insurgent
programme.desc: Now on the run from Jeanine and the rest of the power-hungry Erudites, Tris and Four search for allies and answers in the ruins of Chicago. They must find out what Tris' family sacrificed their lives to protect and why the Erudites will do anything to stop them. Side by side, Tris and Four face one seemingly insurmountable challenge after another, as they unravel the secrets of the past and -- ultimately -- the future of their world.

programme.title: The Divergent Series: Allegiant
programme.desc: Tris escapes with Four to journey beyond the wall that encloses Chicago. For the first time, they leave the only city and family they have ever known to find a peaceful solution. Once outside, they learn shocking new truths that render old discoveries meaningless. As the ruthless battle threatens humanity, Tris and Four quickly decide who to trust to survive. Tris must ultimately make difficult choices about courage, allegiance, sacrifice and love.

programme.title: Power Rangers
programme.desc: Five ordinary teens must become something extraordinary when they learn that their small town of Angel Grove - and the world - is on the verge of being obliterated by an alien threat. Chosen by destiny, our heroes quickly discover they are the only ones who can save the planet. But to do so, they will have to overcome their real-life issues and, before it's too late, band together as the Power Rangers.

programme.desc: Beneath a woman's striking beauty lies a secret that will unleash her indelible strength and skill to become one of the most feared assassins on the planet.

programme.title: Bangkok Dangerous
programme.desc: Remorseless assassin Joe (Nicolas Cage) is in Thailand to complete a series of contract killings for a crime boss called Surat (Nirattisai Kaljaruek). He hires a street punk named Kong (Shahkrit Yamnam) to run errands for him, all the while planning to kill the youth at the conclusion of his assignment. Instead, Joe becomes Kong's unlikely mentor, and begins a tentative romance with a local shop girl. But as Joe begins to let his guard down, Surat decides it is time to clean house.

programme.title: Dominique
programme.desc: Dominique, a well-trained assassin, flees from her troubled past in an attempt to begin a new life in South America.

programme.title: Mechanic: Resurrection
programme.desc: Living undercover in Brazil, master assassin Arthur Bishop (Jason Statham) springs back into action after an old enemy (Sam Hazeldine) kidnaps the woman (Jessica Alba) he loves. To save her life, Bishop must kill an imprisoned African warlord, a human trafficker (Toby Eddington) and an arms dealer (Tommy Lee Jones), all while making the deaths look like accidents. When things don't go exactly as planned, Bishop turns the tables on the people who forced him out of retirement.

programme.title: The Protégé
programme.desc: Rescued as a child by the legendary assassin Moody, Anna is the world's most skilled contract killer. However, when Moody is brutally killed, she vows revenge for the man who taught her everything she knows. As Anna becomes entangled with an enigmatic killer, their confrontation turns deadly, and the loose ends of a life spent killing weave themselves ever tighter.

With Kyle and Sarah now frightened captives, Kyle knows he must use every negotiating trick in his book, for once Elias and his men get what they want, the Millers will likely be killed.

programme.title: Mind Universe
programme.desc: At 79, Heejin bids farewell to her husband Sunwoo, with whom she spent over 40 years. Desiring to meet her husband again, she encounters Sunwoo in his 30s form, restored as an AI through the Mind Upload system. In order to make the memory data more complete, Heejin awakens the unfamiliar ego of Sunwoo in a void state, and each time she connects, her husband's memories are reset to zero. As Heejin repeatedly meets with her husband while holding onto the memories alone, she gradually becomes exhausted. Separation, and Meeting: AI Memory Recovery Virtual World "Tomorrow's Today" In the near yet distant future, in the online funeral service ""Our Universe"" provided by AI, Sound, a space explorer, receives news of the death of her father, composer Kim Hyeongseok, while crossing the Sothell Galaxy. Adapting to the contactless era, Sound utilizes an online condolence service app that allows her to engage in video chats with the deceased, who have been uploaded by artificial intelligence, during the three-day funeral period. Invited to the online funeral, Sound's father Hyeongseok and his acquaintances begin to journey through memories together. Though her father was a famous composer, Sound, who always prioritized work, can only watch his actions without being able to offer words readily.

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.desc: Baby Lullaby takes your baby on a soothing journey with classical lullabies by Bach, Brahms and Mozart. Enjoy relaxing ocean waves, sweet puppet shows and tranquil images. From fun time to rest time, Baby Lullaby is the perfect way to spend special time with your baby.

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.desc: World Music introduces you and your little one to beautiful sounds from every continent, bringing a fresh, new experience of music and culture. Sing, dance and play to exotic rhythms that open the door to an appreciation of different cultures from around the world.

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.desc: Baby's innate curiosity about all they see and hear increases on a daily basis. Before long, they begin to associate words with objects and to imitate and articulate sounds. Why not give their eyes and ears something wonderful to feast upon? Baby Shakespeare presents little ones with 12 common words that can be found within the rich context of classic poems and the beauty of nature.

programme.title: The Sandbox
programme.desc: The Sandbox is where our favorite Baby Einstein characters gather to play, problem-solve and have fun. Each five-minute episode explores an area of curiosity relevant to our 2-4 year old audience. Since the four weathered planks of wood that make up the structure of their sandbox are no obstacles for their imaginations, the entire universe is available to them for each new adventure.

programme.title: Manners Manor
programme.desc: Introducing "Manners Manor," a new series from Baby Einstein. Designed to help your child learn all about manners in a fun and thoughtful way. The content is based on "The Einstein Way" - a curiosity-driven learning philosophy, from industry experts, inspired by Montessori and STEAM. It also reflects our core belief that curiosity is the most important skill for our kids to learn in order to be successful and adaptable in an ever-changing world.

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.desc: Join our playful puppet host, Bard the Dragon, on a fun-filled adventure using everyday words such as flower, cat, and moon, and beautiful scenery from nature. World Of Words lets you and your little one share the excitement of discovering new words together!

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.desc: Sharing the joys and traditions of the holiday season with your little one is truly one of the greatest gifts of parenthood, and Baby Santa's Music Box makes this magical time even more special! programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.desc: Baby Mozart is an introduction to Mozart's beautiful music, which has been proven to have positive affects on people of all ages, especially babies. Images of brightly colored toys and known objects aid in the audio presentation of child-friendly arrangements and sound effects.
